cohort: Newborns of preeclamptic mothers hospitalized in a neonatology unit in Dakar, Senegal.
finding: Neonatal complications in newborns of preeclamptic mothers included prematurity (66%), intrauterine growth retardation, respiratory distress, and perinatal asphyxia.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed in 97.6% of the births.
